week_source.rule: earliest week with any game lacking a final score; a week whose Thursday game is final but whose Sunday and Monday games are not is still the current week
week_source.resolution: games.csv says week 7 and Sleeper's state/nfl says 6. Every game of the earlier week (6) has a final score (14/14), so the rule takes the LATER of the two: week 7. Sleeper's state flag lags a day after Monday night.

kickoff_check.rule: gameday+gametime are America/New_York wall clock, converted to UTC with zoneinfo; end = kick + 190 minutes
kickoff_check.dst_ends: 2026-11-01, so weeks 1-8 kick at 00:15Z Friday and weeks 9-17 at 01:15Z Friday

dst.scoring: 1 sack, 2 INT, 2 fumble rec, 6 TD, 2 safety, 2 block, PA tiers
dst.projection: opponent implied total from the betting line (total/2 -/+ spread/2), integrated across the points-allowed tiers rather than taking the tier of the mean, plus sack, takeaway, defensive-touchdown, block and safety rates shrunk toward league average

two_sided_check.method: defensive columns aggregated by team against the opposing offences' sacks_suffered and passing_interceptions aggregated by opponent_team

proj_source: Sleeper projected stat lines where the feed lists the player, model stat lines elsewhere

proj_model.baseline: rest-of-season rank curve (the weekly file covers week 6, not week 7, so its grades and projections are not used as the baseline)
proj_model.avail: the injury report is a flag, never a multiplier; avail is 1.0 on every player

notes: the feed's team field is reported and never written back: overwriting it would desync opp, home and bye as well
matched on normalized name + position only; relayed ids are discarded

variance.method: pooled within-player weekly standard deviation, 2026 to date
variance.form: sigma = intercept + slope * projected points, floored

scoring_note: The Sleeper league's scoring_settings were re-read from Sleeper this run: 44 keys, no material change from the previous build. The first read omitted ['fgmiss'] and a second targeted read found {"fgmiss": -1.0} present, so those were restored rather than shipped missing: a dropped key silently reverts the league's scoring with nothing on screen to say so, and the relay's own key counts disagreed across the two reads (43 then 42, against 44 real keys).
week_note: Week 6 is played and Week 7 is next. Every game of Week 6 has a final score in the schedule (14/14) and Week 7 has 14 of 14 games still without one, so Week 7 is the week being played. Sleeper's own state/nfl still reads week 6, which it does until the day after Monday night; the rule takes the later week only because Week 6 is complete. Season production and every rate covers weeks 1-6. BUF, JAX, LAC, WAS are on bye, so their players carry no projection for this week. Betting lines exist through Week 7, about one week ahead, which is why defenses beyond that have no market-based projection.
proj_note: Sleeper answered every call this run, so the Week 7 projections are a live read: 262 stat lines (K 27, QB 29, RB 71, TE 62, WR 73), matched to the player database by normalised name and position with the relayed ids discarded, and 0 feed names left unmatched. 296 players carry a model stat line instead, marked ~. Both are stat lines, so both score through each league's own table; only a feed line is a projection. The FantasyPros weekly consensus covers week 6, NOT week 7, so it is not the model's baseline this run - the rest-of-season rank curve is, with recent form and the opponent's points allowed moving a player along it. The injury report is a flag and never a multiplier: avail is 1.0 on every player, and 54 players carry a designation from the week 6 report for the reader to confirm before lock. Defenses price off the Week 7 betting lines.
